title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll dealt The Kitchen Bench, mid-century Laminex and enamel. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Kitchen Bench
options.lineage: 1950s-60s Australian kitchens: Laminex benchtops, enamel canister sets, chrome edge trim
options.thesis: Each slot of the day owns an enamel canister colour, kept everywhere it appears.
options.viewport: Today: the next meal large in its slot colour, the rest of the day as a stack of colour-lidded rows, then the shop at a glance; bottom bar Today, Plan, Shop, Meals, More.
options.risk: Five slot colours plus state colours can turn busy if anything else takes colour.

raised.raise: Guide words: the sticky header always names the span in view (Mon 19 to Sun 25, or Dairy to Pantry in the shop).
Nothing disappears, it cancels: ticked shopping lines and skipped meals stay in place, struck through.
One next decision: Today leads with the next meal at a large size, not a list.
State by line form: anything not yet sent to the server wears a dashed edge, never a new colour.

options.label: The Fridge-Door Pad
options.lineage: the tear-off weekly planner pad held to the fridge with magnets
options.thesis: The week is the pad on the fridge: a printed grid, marker entries, magnets for people.
options.viewport: Today as the pad's day column: slots ruled down the side, meals in marker ink, a magnet dot per person on what they eat.
options.risk: The most familiar idea for a meal planner; marker type can tip into gimmick.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: Soft cards on a warm ground; the one bright colour is always something you can press.
options.viewport: Today as a column of one-idea cards with a persistent bottom bar.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and reads as a working app at once; loses on identification, any household app could wear it.
options.risk: Pleasant and anonymous: close to the category default.

options.label: Lexicon Page
options.thesis: Black text to a fixed measure, colour quarantined in plates.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a kitchen planner is not a reference book, and it reads as an artifact first.
options.kept: Guide words naming the span in view.

options.label: Jet-Age Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Coupons that stamp themselves used or void.
options.viewport: The week as a coupon book.
options.case: Fuses poorly: travel paperwork is foreign to the kitchen.

options.label: Terminal Yellow Wayfinding
options.thesis: Only the next decision, at monumental scale.
options.viewport: The next meal as a gate sign.
options.case: Fuses partly: strong next-step clarity, but nobody at a stove identifies with a concourse.

options.label: Convention Catalog
options.thesis: Hundreds of stamp-sized cells packed in a numbered grid.
options.case: Fuses poorly: density without a reason for this household's dozens of meals.
options.kept: Whole-cell packing for the meal library.

options.label: Emission-Line Rail
options.thesis: State carried by line form, not hue.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a lab instrument at the stove.
options.kept: Pending state as a dashed line.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean iOS-style meal planner app, executed carefully.
canonCard.viewport: Large-title Today, grouped list of slots, tab bar.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any other app by design.
